LINKS SHAPE — nested vs top-level (agent advice):

  entry.links: [ { to_kven, link_type, note, created } ]

  kven, alts, label, matches, notes, type,

comments.author: hands
comments.text: FROM PURPOSE: PRODUCT PRODUCTION for 'loreBOX', first container datBOX system originally produced for datBOX studio. Current produced ROM "CO.DAT-LORE" is LEGACY product. REQ for new production, read and discuss in full -- DO NOT ASSUME 1:1 COPY OF PREVIOUS ROM.

chunks.body: SKU PURPOSE OVERVIEW

comments.author: hands
comments.text:
PRODUCER datBOX is a material preparation bay for incoming narrative material from various sources. 

The purpose of all datBOX 'datmat card boxes', is the easy storage, management, and later exportation of **vaults** (PRODUCER FORMAT: .datbox NOT .sqlite). The structure of the data must adhere to strict and consistent conventions across products and producers, as all material stored in any **vault** across ALICE_BOX must be ready to be imported into a large scale world-simulator which will ingest the datmat cards into its narrative world graphs. 

Product SKU front end must be 'adorable' and 'inspire repeat usage' while the DBS datbox contains the inserted material in clean and orderly sqlite .datbox vault files.

The datBOX Core is the first spine in a series of products: datBOXes of various kinds which will support different card inserts. The product line will keep a consistent BONES structure for how vaults are loaded/de-loaded, and how card catalogs inside the vaults are viewed, added to, and managed, while still remaining themeable and distinct by type on the surface ROM. 

In the case that the product line were to add an additional feature (support for API, additional settings for the entire product line), the product CORE must allow all ROMs in the line receive the update. 
(REF from histories: Current implementation tried, but shotBOX and promptBOX both failed to inherit or launch properly, and CORE never was a fully realized dream.

chunks.body: BASIC FUNCTIONALITY

comments.author: hands
comments.text:
Product CORE must be capable of:
- loading / deloading saved vaults
- browsing stored mat card decks inside the vault
- browsing stored dat cards inside each card deck
- adding / deleting / editing on all decks and cards inside the vault
- revision history inside of the produced materials
- listening for tools like TPS Machina to send and encode CHIPS onto the cards

Different types of DATMAT CARDS will appear as different SKUs, but the CORE of all should remain shared and/or easy to update across all datBOX applications.
